instructions.name: authorize_swap_leg
docs: A governance-signed, single-use authorization bound to a plan revision.
The default build deliberately rejects it until a reviewed release exists.

instructions.name: execute_swap_leg
docs: The keeper can only pay fees and execute the exact approved CPI envelope.

instructions.name: refund_unswapped_deposit
docs: Partial positions never enter this branch. Late old envelopes fail their
plan lifecycle/revision atomically. Refund remains available under pause.

instructions.name: renew_settlement_plan
docs: Explicit owner extension: no cancellation, inventory release or progress reset.

instructions.name: resolve_settlement_minimums
docs: Owner-signed economic resolution, never an automatic quote fallback.

types.name: QuoteAuthorityPolicy
docs: Governance-controlled signing policy. An initialized policy is still disabled.

types.name: QuoteReceipt
docs: Globally unique quote identity. It remains allocated after execution.

types.name: RouteProgramRegistry
docs: Governance-owned route policy. An uninitialized registry cannot authorize a swap.
Production execution remains separately disabled by an immutable build constant.

types.name: SettlementPlan
docs: One immutable three-leg intent. Signatures and finality evidence live in the durable indexer,
since a Solana program cannot know its enclosing transaction signature at execution time.

fields.name: input_budgets
docs: Immutable accounted budget, never the total balance of a public ATA.

types.name: SwapLegAuthorization
docs: A governance-approved, single-use swap envelope for exactly one plan revision.
The plan separately stores this account's commitment, preventing a self-hashed
instruction from authorizing itself. It stores no private key or signature.
